hooks.text: 横版动作融合roguelike、银河城与刷宝，玩家作为命运之子修复破碎世界并追查真相。
hooks.excerpt: "7th Domain" is a horizontal version action game derived from Roguelike Metroidvania combined with treasure grinding gameplay. You will play a child of destiny who repairs the world and finds the truth of the broken world.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 武器与技能可自由组合，每套搭配都会带来不同战术与战斗体验。
hooks.excerpt: This world provides a variety of combinations of weapons and skills, each of which can bring different strategies and combat experiences.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 大量装备词缀可拼装成不同属性战术，支撑剑与魔法风格的刷装路线。
hooks.excerpt: This world provides a wide variety of equipment affixes, which can be assembled into various attribute tactics. Use such a mechanism to pay tribute to the pursuit of the sword and magic era.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
